title: Budgeted Express-Mesh: Traffic-Aware Link Placement and Deadlock-Free Adaptive Routing
summary: This is a network-on-chip topology-routing co-design that replaces a standard mesh interconnect with a mesh augmented by a few traffic-aware express links placed under a fixed wire budget, using greedy placement refined by simulated annealing and committed top-K adaptive routing. It costs wire-budget allocation, placement optimization compute, and routing logic complexity, all at chip-design level. It can fail when traffic patterns deviate from those used to guide link placement, and it is entirely irrelevant to ML inference or training on a single 24 GB GPU or API-based stack.
rationale: The technique targets hardware NoC design, not any layer of the ML software or serving stack the reader operates.
technique: Traffic-aware express-link placement with adaptive NoC routing
